content_sections.heading: About RECPDCL Senior Consultant (Renewable Energy)
content_sections.text: REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL) {formerly known as REC Power Distribution Company Limited} is a wholly owned subsidiary of REC Ltd., a “Maharatna CPSE” under Ministry of Power, Government of India. RECPDCL is rendering expert consultancy services across the value chain of Indian power sector. The spectrum of consultancy services includes inter-alia, Project Management Consultancy (PMC) works, IT implementation in Power Sector, Smart Metering, Smart Grid, Solar Projects, Third Party Quality Inspection, Monitoring of Rural Electrification works, Feeder Renovation Program, Energy Audit, HVDS study, Load flow study of power system networks, preparation of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), Implementation of Power Transmission projects and such others. Also, RECPDCL is closely associated with various Govt. of India Schemes viz., R-APDRP, IPDS, PMDP, RFMS, NFMS etc. and is working in close association with the Central/ State power utilities across the Country.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy themselves that they are eligible to apply for the post and meeting with the requirements and terms and conditions mentioned. Essential: Regular Full-time B.E. / B. Tech. or equivalent in any discipline from a recognised Institute/ University. Desirable: Post-Graduate Diploma in Management/MBA/M.E./M. Tech. Post-qualification experience in the renewable energy sector, with proven experience in planning, development, implementation, operation, or consultancy of renewable energy projects including Solar, Wind, Hybrid RE, BESS, Pumped Storage, Green Hydrogen, or other clean energy projects. Desirable Relevant experience shall include but not limited to: Experience in preparation of feasibility studies, DPRs, techno-commercial evaluation, financial analysis, bid process management (RFQ/RFP), contract management, and project execution under EPC, IPP, PPP, or Developer models. Experience in regulatory compliance, power evacuation and grid integration, stakeholder coordination, and liaison with Government agencies, Utilities, DISCOMs, Developers, Financial Institutions, and Regulatory Authorities. Experience in identification and assessment of renewable energy business opportunities, project due diligence, risk assessment, project monitoring, and advisory support for renewable energy and energy transition initiatives. Individuals retired/separated at the level of E8 from CPSE Level 13 & 14 as per 7th CPC in Govt. of India For others, minimum CTC of Rs. 42.5 lakhs per annum.
